narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='m1'/>Multiply the two gaps. Twelve times eighteen gives two hundred and sixteen minutes.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>Both bells do ring together at that minute, since twelve and eighteen both divide into it.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>But they ring together much earlier as well, so that slip is not the first time.

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>A minute on both lists is a common multiple, and the first one is the lowest common multiple.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>Break the gaps into primes and keep the most copies of each.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>Your turn. Two lamps blink every fourteen and every thirty five minutes. When do they blink together again?
